description: The Donut Chart by r42 offers a modern take on the classic pie chart. With advanced styling options, label connectors, and center content, it provides a clear and attractive way to display proportional data. It features customizable inner radius and slice spacing to match your design needs. The visual includes smart label positioning with connectors for clarity and allows for center content to display summary metrics, all within a fully responsive design.
